# ♿ Accessibility Statement for Jarvis-AI

We are committed to ensuring digital accessibility for everyone, including people with disabilities. We are continually improving the user experience for all users and applying relevant accessibility standards.

---

## 🎯 Our Goals
We strive to make **Jarvis-AI**:
- **Navigable:** Fully accessible using keyboard shortcuts and screen readers where applicable.
- **Readable:** Visual elements have sufficient contrast, and interface components are clearly described.
- **Inclusive:** Designed to support assistive technologies.

---

## 🛠️ Feedback & Assistance
We welcome your feedback on the accessibility of Jarvis-AI. If you encounter accessibility barriers, experience issues with screen readers, or need information in alternative formats, please let us know:

* **Discord Community:** Join our [Discord Server](https://discord.com/invite/r5q93NpRPt) and reach out to the maintainers.
* **GitHub Issues:** Open an issue on our repository describing the accessibility barrier you encountered.

We try to respond to feedback within 48 hours and work towards resolving accessibility concerns promptly.
